title: Vendors page opens without the Reports permission
custom_preconds:
1. You have a role with these permissions turned ON: Vendor & Order Management → View, and See Financial Data.
  2. The Reports permission is turned OFF for that role.
  3. A user is signed in with that role.
custom_expected:
The Vendors page opens normally and shows the vendor list.

You are NOT sent to an "Access restricted" / Access Denied screen.

Opening Vendors does not require the Reports permission — Vendors access depends only on Vendor & Order Management → View.
refs: SV-8682 (Custom Roles & Permissions §Vendor & Order Management — View grants Vendors/Purchase Orders/Deliveries visibility)
evidence: LIVE 2026-07-27, staging: impersonated a role with atoms {vendorOrderManagementView, seeFinancialData} (Reports OFF, atoms confirmed via GET /api/auth/me/fe-permissions). Loaded /parts/vendors in Chromium → FINAL URL stayed /parts/vendors, Vendors table rendered, ZERO 4xx (GET /api/parts-catalogue/vendors = 200). Also /parts/orders, /parts/deliveries, /parts/vendor-invoices, /parts/returns all loaded with no 4xx. SV-8682 NOT reproduced on current staging build. Screenshot: evidence/SV8682-vendors-reportsoff-LOADS.png
note: Regression guard. Currently PASSES on staging (bug not reproducible); the ticket is still Code Review, so keep this case to catch any re-introduction of the Reports dependency.
